title: Restart after a position-dependent rewind
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean inputs, let $r$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be an augmented configuration in rewind phase at $(j,c)$, with $0\le j\le r$ and $0\le c\le r+1$. Suppose $j<r$. Then, for every Boolean word $u$ of length at most $q+2$, where $q$ is the input-head position after one attempted move to the left from $C$, running the amplified machine from $C$ leaves all work-tape head positions unchanged; and for every such word of length exactly $q+2$, the resulting configuration is the restart of $C$ at index $j+1$ and counter $c$.
